# Ny mand jagter Store Penge

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-09-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish episode of Store Penge introduces psychologist and investor Tobias Storm as the new manager of the Store Penge portfolio. He is targeting +25% by year-end, with a concentrated portfolio built around companies reporting soon, software, cybersecurity, AI infrastructure and crypto. The panel also discussed Elon Musk's claims about robotics and electricity demand, where gas turbines and fuel cells were seen as beneficiaries, and China's oil trade with Iran in yuan. Other topics were rising US 10-year yields (about 4.8%) weighing on growth stocks, a possible EU cybersecurity spending push that could help European names, and the US Trump accounts for children.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 DE — John Deere | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Mikkel's favourite robotics exposure: an autonomous-machinery leader, held in the Store Penge portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikkel Rosenvold prefers John Deere over pure humanoid names for robotics exposure. He argues it is effectively an AI company, far ahead in self-driving and autonomous machines for construction and road work, and notes it has been a fantastic investment for two years. The stock is held in the show's portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if autonomy adoption in agriculture or construction stalls
- if robotics valuations deflate broadly

> *"Jeg synes, når vi taler robotter, at det mest spændende holder jeg mig stadigvæk til, er at investere i John Deere eller Caterpillar."*

---

### 🟢 CAT — Caterpillar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Paired with John Deere as the preferred autonomous robotics play; held in the Store Penge portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikkel Rosenvold sees Caterpillar as a practical robotics and AI winner through autonomous machines for road work and construction sites. It has performed strongly over two years and is held in the show's portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the autonomous-machinery lead erodes
- if the construction cycle turns sharply down

> *"Fordi de er så langt fremme på selvkørende teknologi og autonome robotter, der kan arbejde på alt fra vejearbejde til byggepladser osv."*

---

### 🟠 BE — Bloom Energy | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Joachim expects the data-centre power gap to be filled by on-site generation, making Bloom interesting to look at.

#### Reasoning

Joachim Brygman argues the US cannot fix grid capacity in time for AI data-centre demand, so on-site power such as gas turbines will fill the gap. Even Musk uses turbines. He calls Bloom Energy and suppliers of grid batteries interesting to look at.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the grid build-out accelerates faster than expected
- if data-centre capex slows

> *"så det er jo i høj grad sådan nogen, som Bloom Energy kunne det være. som er interessant at kigge på"*

---

### 🟠 TSLA — Tesla | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as perhaps the best humanoid-robotics bet, though the panel noted Musk's hype incentive and Tesla's broader exposure.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel suggested Tesla may be the best bet within humanoid robotics, which explains why Musk hypes the sector. The panel qualified this: Musk has a conflict of interest, his timelines are unreliable, and Tesla is not a pure robotics play.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the humanoid robot timeline slips further
- if Musk's claims keep failing to materialise

> *"I virkeligheden er det allerbedste bet inden for det her jo måske Tesla, hvilket jo understreger også, hvorfor Elon Musk hyper den her sektor."*

---

### 🟠 HO — Thales | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Expected EU cybersecurity act and investment packages could support European cyber names.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel expects the Irish EU presidency to focus heavily on cybersecurity after an escalation of Russian hybrid attacks. Europe will likely prefer European suppliers, which supports Thales.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU cyber spending packages fail to materialise

> *"men der findes altså også nogle europæiske Thales og OVH og Secunet og andre, som vi har lidt kigget på."*

---

### 🟠 YSN — Secunet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A European cybersecurity name set to benefit from EU cyber investment and a preference for European solutions.

#### Reasoning

This is the same thesis as Thales: massive expected EU cybersecurity spending directed at European vendors amid rising Russian hybrid attacks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU cyber spending packages fail to materialise

> *"Jeg tror, der kommer til at blive investeret massiv penge for Europa. Og det vil man jo helst gøre i europæiske løsninger."*

---

### 🟠 OVH — OVH | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

A European tech/cloud name that could gain from an EU push for European cyber solutions.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel lists OVH among European names his team has looked at that could benefit from EU cybersecurity investment and a preference for European solutions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU spending favours US hyperscalers

> *"men der findes altså også nogle europæiske Thales og OVH og Secunet og andre, som vi har lidt kigget på."*

---

### ⛔ DJT — Trump Media & Technology Group | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Down 85% with minimal revenue; Joachim expects it to approach zero as the presidency winds down.

#### Reasoning

Joachim ridicules the stock: revenue equals a shawarma bar despite presidential promotion, few subscriptions have been sold, and it is likely to trend toward zero as Trump's remaining term shrinks.

> *"Den begynder nok at nærme sig 0 i takt med, at der ikke er flere dage tilbage af hans præsidentskab."*

---

### 🟡 JPM — JPMorgan | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Tobias still holds financials that are defending his portfolio amid a growth-stock sell-off.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias Storm keeps defensive exposure to financials such as JPMorgan, which have held up while rising US yields hit growth stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rotation back into growth stocks accelerates

> *"Og det kan jo være aktier som, ja, DPMorgan, Visa, inden for olie- og gas, Chevron, Exxon"*

---

### 🟡 V — Visa | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

A financial Tobias holds that is keeping his portfolio afloat.

#### Reasoning

Tobias Storm holds Visa as defensive financial exposure in a volatile, rate-driven market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rotation back into growth stocks accelerates

---

### 🟡 CVX — Chevron | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

An oil and gas holding benefiting from the flare-up of the US-Iran conflict.

#### Reasoning

Tobias Storm keeps oil and gas exposure through Chevron, which has held up as oil rose on the US-Iran tensions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US-Iran conflict de-escalates and oil falls

---

### 🟡 XOM — Exxon | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

An oil and gas holding that supports the portfolio amid geopolitical tension.

#### Reasoning

Tobias Storm holds Exxon for oil and gas exposure, which has helped his portfolio during the sell-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US-Iran conflict de-escalates and oil falls

---

### 🟡 HUM — Humana | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

A health insurer that has performed fine amid market uncertainty.

#### Reasoning

Tobias Storm keeps exposure to US health insurers such as Humana, which have held up recently.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rotation back into growth stocks accelerates

---

### 🟡 UNH — UnitedHealth | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

A health insurer that has performed fine amid market uncertainty.

#### Reasoning

Tobias Storm holds UnitedHealth as part of his defensive health insurance exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rotation back into growth stocks accelerates

> *"Der har vi de amerikanske Humana, United Health"*

---
